attr.title: GoldenEye 007
attr.desc: Alpha native AArch64/GLES GoldenEye 007 source port for R36S with the ARM-GE Glass Control Deck and a launchable automated benchmark suite. Supply your own verified US NTSC ROM; first launch generates ROM-derived sidecars locally.
attr.inst: Install ge007.zip normally with PortMaster. Two Ports entries are installed: 'GoldenEye 007' for normal play and 'GoldenEye Benchmark' for the automated performance suite. Put your own US NTSC ROM at ge007/data/ge007.ntsc-final.z64.
